name: The Prime Number Generator Database
description: A prime number generator finds prime numbers: type a limit, press Generate, and read the primes. 7 is prime: its only divisors are 1 and 7. The first 5 primes are 2, 3, 5, 7 and 11, and they add to 28. There are 10 primes below 30. Everything runs in this browser; no data leaves the page.
